original_ai_output.title_zh: Ebi Bright 声称其司机在与 Tema Central 议员纠纷中遭袭击
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳 Tema 大都会首席执行官 Ebi Bright 声称，其与 Tema Central 议员 Charles Forson 的纠纷升级，导致她的一名司机在试图与该议员接触时遭袭击。该说法目前为单一来源，尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: Ebi Bright 声称其司机在与 Tema Central 议员 Charles Forson 的纠纷中遭袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tema Metropolitan Chief Executive Ebi Bright has alleged that a dispute with Tema Central Member of Parliament Charles Forson has escalated to the point where one of her drivers was assaulted during an attempt to engage the legislator.

key_facts.fact: 该事件目前仅有一个来源报道

uncertainties: 司机遭袭击的说法为 Ebi Bright 单方面指控，尚未获得独立证实
事件具体经过与责任方尚不清楚
